caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Did You Know your favorite song, photo, and even this text message are all just combinations of only TWO numbers? 🤯

💡 Every digital experience, from songs to photos, is built from countless tiny 0s and 1s – like billions of invisible light switches. This binary code is the universal language of computers and AI.
